fact: The SADC Climate Services Centre, hosted by Botswana's Department of Meteorological Services, uses satellite vegetation products (Proba-V/Copernicus) and satellite rainfall estimates for agriculture and drought monitoring, which assisted drought assessment in Botswana leading to its 2015 drought declaration; a regional centre, not a national service alone.
title: Satellite data in support of weather, water and climate services in the SADC region
publisher: SADC Secretariat (Climate Services Centre) for EUMETSAT
